account: On 8 October 2025 a 16-year-old was reported missing after failing to return to the psychiatric facility in Hesse where she lived. A farewell letter pointed to an acute psychological crisis. Indications placed her in Frankfurt's Bahnhofsviertel. Citing imminent danger, Frankfurt's police president issued an emergency order, confirmed by a judge. So her photograph could be entered into the AI-assisted camera system running in the district since July 2025. It operates under the Hessian police law amended in February 2025. Late on 9 October the system flagged a match on Taunusstraße. A video operator checked it and a patrol confirmed it. Officers took the girl into protective custody and returned her to the child and adolescent psychiatric facility.

ai_role.statement: The police press release documents the system's contribution step by step. After a judge-confirmed emergency order, the girl's photo was entered into the database. Late on 9 October the AI produced an automated match alert for Taunusstraße. A video operator checked it and a patrol confirmed it in person. The police had only indications that she might be in the district, so the AI supplied the place and the moment. Human verification and the patrol did the rest. Whether and how soon conventional patrols would have found her is not reported.

fields.account: On 8 October 2025 a 16-year-old was reported missing after failing to return to the psychiatric facility in Hesse where she lived. A farewell letter pointed to an acute psychological crisis. Indications placed her in Frankfurt's Bahnhofsviertel. Citing imminent danger, Frankfurt's police president issued an emergency order, confirmed by a judge. So her photograph could be entered into the AI-assisted camera system running in the district since July 2025. It operates under the Hessian police law amended in February 2025. Late on 9 October the system flagged a match on Taunusstraße. A video operator checked it and a patrol confirmed it. Officers took the girl into protective custody and returned her to the child and adolescent psychiatric facility.

purpose: The Bahnhofsviertel Videoschutzanlage's AI performs real-time biometric remote identification.
